_about: What only people can establish, each with the date and the commit it was about (`at`): reviews (kind code, security or docs, and openHigh, the count of open high findings), sightings in the real app, a cold install by someone who is not the founder, and new tests watched failing first. Tests, versions and validation are measured by tools/quality.py and never written here. A fact is fresh only while the plugin has not changed since `at`. Never raise a claim above its evidence.
